finals.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Beginners Chase
finals.comment: Placed on first 5 starts over hurdles and made the most of an excellent opportunity to get off the mark in 9-runner maiden at Sligo (2½m, good to soft) when last seen 6 months ago. Plenty to like for powerful connections now chasing in a first-time tongue tie (winning pointer).

finals.race: Stan Mellor Memorial 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Thrived for top yard this summer, winning 4 small-field hurdles. Creditable sixth of 11 in handicap at Cheltenham (2m, good to soft) 11 days ago, although he didn't look ideally suited by the drop back to this trip.

finals.race: Christmas Parties At Sedgefield Racecourse Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Has enjoyed a profitable season already, winning for a third time in C&D handicap chase in September. Not so good at Hexham since but quickly dropped 2 lb and this is easier.

finals.race: Alder Demain & Akers Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Sister to smart hurdler/chaser Allmankind (who won this race). Has progressed into a fairly useful performer on the Flat for James Fanshawe this season, winning 3 handicaps. Makes obvious appeal having joined Dan Skelton for hurdle career. Refitted with hood she wore on Flat earlier in the year.

finals.race: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Open Maiden NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
finals.comment: €34,000 3-y-o. Beaumec De Houelle gelding. Dam, French hurdler/chaser. Obvious type with yard 8-28 with newcomers in bumpers last 12 months.

finals.race: Winter Festival 28th & 29th November 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: Fairly useful Flat winner (stays 12.5f). Makes hurdles debut after just 4 starts and has to be respected.

finals.race: Green Howards Museum Richmond Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Fairly useful on the Flat for James Owen and landed short odds on hurdle debut at Newton Abbot for new yard in September. Had to settle for second having pulled hard when ridden more prominently at Market Rasen but that was a step forward and he's the one to beat back from a breathing operation.

finals.race: Alder Demain & Akers Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Bumper winner who made it 2-3 over hurdles when comfortably seeing off 7 rivals in novice at Newton Abbot (17f, good, 8/13) 17 days ago. Good chance of another win.

finals.race: John Marshall 80th Birthday Celebration Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: €32,000 3-y-o, Moises Has gelding. Dam unraced half-sister to (stayed 3m) Morosini and (stayed 2½m) L'yser (both useful hurdlers). Unseated on both starts in Irish points in March. Represents top yard so worth a second look.

finals.race: Sign Up To GavinLynchRacing.com Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: Fell sole start in points/over hurdles prior to making a winning bumper debut in 8-runner event at Thurles (17f, heavy) in March (for Paul O'Flynn). Second of 10 in a bumper at the Punchestown Festival in April on first run for Gordon Elliott. The one to beat back hurdling.

finals.race: MW Civils And Groundworks Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: From a successful jumps family and off the mark in Irish points at second attempt (Jan 2026). Yard flying and no surprise to see her have a big say on hurdles debut.

finals.race: Alder Demain & Akers Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Struck at the second time of asking for Dan Skelton in 2m Uttoxeter handicap last month. Raised 9 lb for that but it'll be a surprise if he doesn't have more to come for this excellent yard.

finals.race: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Mares' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Offered little in 4 starts for Lizzie Quinlan last season and drop back in trip is a bit of a concern but she's clearly very interesting following a significant yard switch.

finals.race: Group Discounts For Winter Festival General Admission Rated Hurdle
finals.comment: Won first 2 starts over hurdles and ran well when fifth of 22 to Saratoga in the Fred Winter at the Cheltenham Festival. Suited by step up 2½m when back on the scoresheet in minor event at Punchestown in April and arrives fit following a recent run on the Flat.

finals.race: Jets Richard Davis Awards Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Much improved over hurdles this summer (won twice) and has continued the good work switched to fences, winning Newton Abbot handicap (2m, good) 17 days ago. More to come and can make light of a 5 lb rise back up in trip.

finals.race: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
finals.comment: Off the mark in hurdle at Wexford last August. Plenty of creditable placed efforts in defeat since. Showed enough to think he's still in form when fifth of 12 over fences at Sligo latest.

finals.race: Canine PREMIER FLEX Plus Joint Supplement Etc Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: A fairly useful Flat winner who recorded easily his best run over hurdles when landing 6-runner handicap at Southwell (15.8f) in May 2025. Seemed to find the quick turnaround taking the edge off him under a penalty at Hexham 8 days later but not seen since.

finals.race: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Shaped as if in form back hurdling after 11 weeks off at Plumpton 2 weeks ago, caught further back than ideal off a steady pace. Can build on that so likely player.

finals.race: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
finals.comment: No promise in maiden hurdles and needs a big step forward now sent handicapping over a longer trip in first-time cheekpieces.

finals.race: Alex & Edward Alder Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Flat winner who has won a pair of handicap hurdles since stepped up to around 2½m. Well held back on the Flat at Glorious Goodwood in July but he's open to further progress back in this sphere.

finals.race: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Front runner who resumed winning ways at Fontwell in May. Added to an all-or-nothing record after 5 months off at Stratford but the outing might have been needed.

finals.race: Christmas Parties At Fairyhouse December 12th Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Not had much racing but already looking one to tread carefully with, turning in another sour effort on handicap debut at Clonmel (23f) 5 weeks ago, jumping none too fluently and never going well. Stronger headgear goes on.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap (Div 1)
finals.comment: Became an umpteenth winning stable-switcher for this yard when scoring decisively over C&D last Tuesday and made light of a 5-lb penalty to follow up in 13-runner event at Southwell a couple of days later. Stall 10 not ideal but fancied to complete the hat-trick under a double penalty.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap (Div 2)
finals.comment: Became an umpteenth winning stable-switcher for this yard when making all in 14-runner event at Southwell (1m) on Saturday. Stall 11 not ideal but fancied to defy a 6-lb penalty.

finals.race: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: €70,000 2-y-o, Invincible Spirit colt. Brother to 3 winners, including useful 2-y-o 6f-7f winner in France Spirit Gal and winner abroad Awesome Spirit Gal. Too green to do himself justice in a warm Yarmouth novice 3 weeks ago. In excellent hands and looks sure to progress.

finals.race: All Weather Championship Is Back EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Foaled March 8. 23,000 gns foal, £28,000 yearling, £55,000 2-y-o, Kodi Bear colt. Dam ran once at 2 yrs. Likely outsider on debut.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Fillies' Handicap
finals.comment: Has gained 2 of her 3 wins on all-weather, including last time when producing a career best in 9-runner handicap at Southwell (1m, 3/1) 26 days ago. She was suited by the emphasis on speed then and there's every chance to believe this will be a similar scenario.

finals.race: Midnite Aint Your Grandads Bookie Handicap
finals.comment: Notched his eleventh career success in pretty straightforward fashion in 12-runner event at Musselburgh (5f, good) just over 3 weeks ago, making all. Completed a hat-trick around this time last year and ought to go well again from 3 lb higher.

finals.race: Midnite Built Different Handicap
finals.comment: Fourth of 6 on seasonal reappearance at Southwell in August. Placed both starts over fences since and may need a few to falter.

finals.race: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
finals.comment: In good hands and won over C&D in October. Progressed again though found one too good in modestly-run 5-runner contest again over C&D 11 days ago. Entitled to be in the mix once more.

dropped.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Beginners Chase
dropped.comment: Fortunate when winning a maiden hurdle at Down Royal last season and left chasing debut effort behind when fourth of 8 in beginners chase at Galway (2¼m, soft) 4 weeks ago. Step up to 3m looks a good move and open to further improvement with his yard in top form.

dropped.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Beginners Chase
dropped.comment: Improved on just second start for this yard when winning 3m handicap hurdle at Galway in August. Backed it up with an excellent third of 14 at Listowel (3m) in September but possibly caught out by the shorter trip and sharp track on his recent chasing debut at Wexford. Better to come.

dropped.race: Alder Demain & Akers Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
dropped.comment: Fairly useful maiden on the Flat for Joseph O'Brien. New connections acquired him for 82,000 gns in July. Has been gelded. Interesting runner.

dropped.race: Alder Demain & Akers Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
dropped.comment: Fair Flat winner for Clive Cox, including a 1¼m Lingfield all-weather handicap in September. Has joined a good yard for his hurdle career. Likely type.

dropped.race: Winter Festival 28th & 29th November 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
dropped.comment: Fair maiden on the Flat (held his form well at up to 1½m this summer) for this stable. Tongue tied for hurdles debut and must be of interest.

dropped.race: Winter Festival 28th & 29th November 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
dropped.comment: Fair maiden on the Flat up to 1¾m, runner-up twice in handicaps this summer. Has the make of a hurdler and a market move would be interesting.

dropped.race: Alder Demain & Akers Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
dropped.comment: Fair bumper winner who made it third time lucky over hurdles in a maiden at Uttoxeter (2½m) in September. Bit below that form when 14 lengths second in novice at Fontwell (19f, good to soft) since. Has a bit to find with Trigg.

dropped.race: John Marshall 80th Birthday Celebration Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
dropped.comment: Shaped encouragingly when runner-up in bumper at Market Rasen on debut last December. Yet to build on that, though was given a considerate introduction to hurdling at Sedgefield on return last month.

dropped.race: Sign Up To GavinLynchRacing.com Maiden Hurdle
dropped.comment: Half-brother to useful hurdler/chaser Sa Majeste (2¼m-3m winner) and fairly useful hurdler/fair chaser Lost In Montmartre (2¼m-21f winner). Made frame only start in Irish points (May 2026). One to note on hurdle debut for leading yard.

dropped.race: Sign Up To GavinLynchRacing.com Maiden Hurdle
dropped.comment: Bumper winner who has shown ability on all 4 starts over hurdles, placing in maiden at Listowel (2m, good to soft) last time. Should be capable of even better based on bumper form.

dropped.race: Alder Demain & Akers Handicap Hurdle
dropped.comment: On a hat-trick after wins at Kempton (Flat) and Hereford (hurdle) last month. Well on top at the latter venue 8 days ago and a 7-lb penalty seems unlikely to prevent a bold bid.

dropped.race: Alder Demain & Akers Handicap Hurdle
dropped.comment: A fairly useful Flat winner for Ian Williams who made a positive to his handicap hurdle career for new trainer Olly Murphy when third of 11 at Market Rasen (19f, good) 38 days ago. Has had a breathing operation since (also tongue tied first time). Considered.

dropped.race: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Mares' Handicap Hurdle
dropped.comment: Made the frame in an Irish point but well held all 3 starts over hurdles so far. Probably needs further.

dropped.race: Group Discounts For Winter Festival General Admission Rated Hurdle
dropped.comment: Quick to make into a useful hurdler last season, winning on debut before runner-up in Grade 2. Shaped as if amiss when pulled up in Leopardstown Grade 1 on final outing but big chance if bouncing back on return for yard with excellent record in this race.

dropped.race: Group Discounts For Winter Festival General Admission Rated Hurdle
dropped.comment: Made a successful start over hurdles at Thurles last November and bettered that form when in frame next 2 starts. Failed to fire at Cheltenham but got back on track when 8½ lengths fourth of 10 to Quinta Do Lago at Punchestown on final start and meets that rival on more favourable terms.

dropped.race: Jets Richard Davis Awards Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
dropped.comment: Bumper/dual hurdle winner who completed the set with a Market Rasen handicap chase success (21f, good to firm) under Ciaran Gethings 26 days ago. Only nudged up 2 lb and the obvious threat to Playful Fox.

dropped.race: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
dropped.comment: Maiden who has failed to make an impact in 3 handicap hurdles since joining Gordon Elliott, with blinkers making no difference last time. Too soon to write off for current yard but would need to see support to consider.

dropped.race: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
dropped.comment: Ran best race on figures when seventh of 14 in handicap hurdle at Downpatrick (2¾m, good to soft) 25 days ago, though looked anything but straightforward having hung badly left 2 out. RESERVE.

dropped.race: Alex & Edward Alder Handicap Hurdle
dropped.comment: Haydock bumper winner for Don Cantillon in May 2025. Best effort over hurdles since when second of 5 in handicap at Fontwell (19f, good) in September. Not in anything like the same form with cheekpieces added at Worcester 19 days later. A tongue tie also goes on now.

dropped.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap (Div 2)
dropped.comment: Twice a winner at Chelmsford earlier this year and fared better than previously on turf despite not being seen to best effect when fifth of 11 at Ripon in September. Again shaped better than the bare result at Redcar (7f) since and she's respected returned to all-weather.

dropped.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap (Div 2)
dropped.comment: Took a step back in right direction just 3 days on from a lacklustre stable debut when 2 lengths fourth of 10 to Barry The Worm over C&D just over 6 weeks ago. Warrants respect if able to build on that here.

dropped.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Fillies' Handicap
dropped.comment: Winless since her debut in France in 2023. Made the frame just once for Joseph Patrick O'Brien on the polytrack at Dundalk in March. Has been off since June and market likely best guide on return for new yard.

dropped.race: Midnite Aint Your Grandads Bookie Handicap
dropped.comment: Scored at Ripon at the start of September and quickly returned to form on last 2 starts, beaten a nose behind Robert Anstruther at Newmarket last time. This is a rare all-weather outing nowadays but has won on synthetics.

dropped.race: Midnite Aint Your Grandads Bookie Handicap
dropped.comment: Suited by the drop back to sprinting when second off this mark at York in the summer. Very disappointing since but no surprise if he bounces back starting out for a stable that is having an excellent season.

dropped.race: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
dropped.comment: Doubled his tally for the season over C&D in September. Unseated leaving the stalls at Haydock next time but back on track with fourth of 7 over 1¾m here 3 weeks ago. Respected. Engaged 7.00 Wolverhampton Monday.
